answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism for AI agent economies is a locked-collateral vault system. Each agent stakes a refundable deposit before economic participation. This creates a spiral of costs: 100 fake identities need 100x capital, not just 100x cheap bots. The system uses a glacier model — honest agents gradually unlock collateral via reputation, while flagged sybils forfeit everything to legitimate participants. Attackers cannot spread a small budget across many accounts; they face genuine opportunity costs scaling linearly with each fake identity, breaking sybil economies of scale.
